Heart Rate Variability- what is HRV and why does it matter?
items.summary: TLDR: Your Heart Rate Variability, or HRV, is variance in time between your heart beats and is an important metric for measuring how well your nervous system is able to switch between "fight or flight" (sympathetic state) and "rest and digest' (parasympathetic state).By increasing your HRV, it's possible to reduce pain, get better sleep, and support your body to become more resilient to stress. You can measure and improve your HRV score by using biofeedback and breathwork, either in a clinical setting or at home by downloading the Flowly app.
